name: troubleshoot-ui-deadlock
prompt: A WPF window freezes when a button invokes an async service and the code calls .Result. Determine the root cause and implement a safe correction.
rubric: Distinguishes dispatcher deadlock or blocking waits from CPU work and external timeout.
Removes sync-over-async through an async call chain rather than recommending Task.Run universally.
Validates responsiveness, cancellation, exception flow, and repeated invocation.
